summary: Renders a text string twice at the same position to produce a drop-shadow effect. Both passes format a 64-byte stack buffer via sub_49C8F0 / sub_49C960 and call UITextRenderWithScale with color 0xFFFFFF at (a1 + 245, 10) at scale 1.0: first a shadow pass (mode 1, alignment 2), then a foreground pass (mode 0, alignment 1). Returns the foreground render result. No static frame-path callers; not on the tick frame path.

operations.description: Call sub_49C8F0(v2, 64): prepare the 64-byte text buffer for the shadow pass.
Call UITextRenderWithScale(v2, a1 + 245, 10, 0xFFFFFF, 1, 2, 1.0, 1.0): shadow render pass with mode 1 and alignment 2.
Call sub_49C960(v2, 64): prepare the 64-byte text buffer for the foreground pass.
Call UITextRenderWithScale(v2, a1 + 245, 10, 0xFFFFFF, 0, 1, 1.0, 1.0): foreground render pass with mode 0 and alignment 1.
Return the integer result of the foreground UITextRenderWithScale call.

unresolved: Meaning of the UITextRenderWithScale mode (1 vs 0) and alignment (2 vs 1) parameters.
What the integer argument a1 points to and what the offset +245 selects.
Internal behavior of sub_49C8F0 / sub_49C960 beyond formatting a 64-byte buffer.
Reason the shadow/foreground passes use different alignment parameters.
